name: Human Judgment Displacement
definition: Automation replaces judgment in a setting that required judgment, and the loss is not detected because the output still looks well formed.
trigger_conditions: Output is fluent and confident regardless of correctness
No sampled human review of accepted outputs occurs
The prior human process left no record to compare against

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: decision makers relying on presumptively optimal rules for want of decentralized information

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F020 Human Judgment Displacement. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F020
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
